title: Ju Sing

Commandant SVC
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）

C. I. D.
I. O. REQ
No. 30
Date 31-1-
January 31st 191 A

Sir,
It is reported that the rebels held a meeting in
Frenchtown on 29th inst when it was announced that no rising
could be started in Shanghai for the present as the
necessary funds could not be secured. Two rebels named
Ju Sing 瞿同 and Paung Ts Tsung 万□ were present at the
meeting. These recently arrived from Japan.
Although the troops at the Arsenal are usually
paid on the last day of each month, they were expecting
to get their wages yesterday in view of the approach
of the Chinese new year. When they found that this
did not come off they were disappointed and they are
now grumbling.
The troops at the Arsenal and Woosung were paid on
30th inst.
The party residing at No.101 Nyung Kong Li, who
are reported to be members of an assassination Corps
intend to remove to Chapei soon. They are at present
searching for a suitable house in that district.

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处
情报官申请
第 30 号
日期 191 年 1 月 31 日

先生：

据报，叛乱分子于本月 29 日在法租界举行会议，会上宣布由于未能筹集到必要资金，目前无法在上海发动起义。两名名为 Ju Sing（瞿同）和 Paung Ts Tsung（万□）的叛乱分子出席了会议。这两人最近刚从日本抵达。

虽然兵工厂的部队通常在每月最后一天发饷，但鉴于中国新年临近，他们原本预计昨天能领到薪饷。当发现未能如愿时，他们感到失望，目前正在抱怨。

兵工厂和吴淞的部队已于本月 30 日发饷。

据报居住在宁波里 101 号的一伙人是暗杀团成员，他们打算不久后搬往闸北。目前他们正在该地区寻找合适的房屋。

(2)                                                                                              191

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

The following is a copy of an answer received by
the rebels in Shanghai in reply to a communication
which they sent to the President of the United States:-

"Sir,

      I have to acknowledge by reference from the
President of the United States your letter addressed
to him and relating to certain advice, said to have
been given to the President of China by Dr.F.Goodnow
recommending the adoption by China of a monarchical
form of Government.

      Due notice has been taken of your observations
thereanent.

                        I am, Sir,
                  Your Obedient Servant,
                for the Secretary of State,
              Second Assistant Secretary ".

                        Your Obedient Servant,
                        [签名]
                  Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

警务处，
（侦探股）

以下是上海叛乱分子收到的一份回复抄件，系对其致美国总统函件的答复：-

“先生：

      兹奉美利坚合众国总统转来阁下致总统之信函，信中提及据称古德诺博士（Dr. F. Goodnow）曾向中国大总统提供建议，劝告中国采用君主立宪政体一事。

      阁下对此事之意见已获充分知悉。

                        先生，
                  您顺从的仆人，
                代表国务卿，
              助理国务卿（第二）”。

                        您顺从的仆人，
                        [签名]
                  总探长。

警察总监
